clock.wall_time: UTC+08:00, estimated from first wire timestamp pair

definitions.server_inference_s: reply.inference_seconds reported by the inference server
definitions.client_predict_minus_server_inference_s: client predict interval minus server inference; includes transport and other work
definitions.source_age: host monotonic event time minus request.source_time
definitions.submit_to_ack_s: logged acknowledgement minus logged submission; includes joint endpoint and any gripper completion
definitions.rpc_return_to_ack_s: logged acknowledgement minus MoveGripper RPC return; not the exact feedback duration
definitions.surrounding_servoj_gap_s: next ServoJ issue minus previous ServoJ return; an upper bound on the contained peripheral lock pause
definitions.completion_detection_bounds: RPC return to the earliest available next ServoJ issue or target ACK; null when neither upper bound is recorded
definitions.prediction_observation: current request state at request.source_time; invalid current state stays invalid
definitions.observation_after_monotonic: previous request retirement ACK used as the lower bound for the next current observation
definitions.prefix_consumed_steps: submitted cursor and ACK cursor are recorded separately; only real ACKs contribute retirement causes
definitions.completion_to_next_s_bounds: next request/source/observation-ready time minus completion upper/lower bounds
definitions.submit_to_stop_s: StopMotion issue minus tail submission, measured for the unacknowledged target
definitions.scheduled_target_minus_stop_s: scheduled tail target time minus StopMotion issue; positive means the stop was issued before the scheduled target

limitations: 13 次夹爪命令的精确完成反馈未写入这些本地控制日志；完成区间及预测采样不等于精确反馈时间。
客户端预测总耗时减去服务端推理耗时仍包含传输及其他处理，不能归因于单一环节。
ServoJ RPC 返回码和夹爪完成反馈不证明物体、轨迹或策略任务结果。
